abhts_18.1.literal: Now (atha) eighteenth-ahnika (aṣṭādaśam āhnikam): one-well-practiced-in-knowledge (svabhyastajñāninaṃ) for-practitioner (sādhakatve) or (vā) for-teacherhood (gurutve) [one should] consecrate (abhiṣiñcet) — because (yataḥ) even-without- all-marks (sarvalakṣaṇahīno 'pi) knowledge-possessing-alone (jñānavān eva) [is] for-practitioner (sādhakatve) for-grace-giving (anugrahakaraṇe ca) entitled (adhikṛtaḥ); not (na) another (anyaḥ) even-consecrated (abhiṣikto 'pi)
